actions.description:
Requirements The dockhand is adjacent to a crate

Effect The dockhand picks up a crate and heaves it up to 15 feet. Upon landing, the crate breaks open in a @Template[type:burst|distance:5]. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:13|basic|options:area-effect] save, and the area is difficult terrain until cleared.
actions.name: Heft Crate
actions.requirements: The dockhand is adjacent to a crate

actions.description: The dockhand Interacts to either draw a bottle of Alcohol or pick up a nearby unattended bottle of alcohol, then drinks the whole thing. For 1 minute, the dockhand gains a +2 item bonus to melee damage rolls and saving throws against fear but is Off-Guard.
actions.name: Swig

name: Dockhand
publicNotes:
Working to load and unload cargo from ships, dockhands are considered unruly, but many stay focused and work hard until the job is done.

Society is built upon the backs of laborers.
